notes.title: Harry's Adventure - Playtest #2 this weekend!
notes.content:
This weekend (starting october 11th), you will once again have open access to playtest Harry's Adventure!

We've been hard at work since the previous testing cycle, adding several new game modes as well as improvements to the online experience as a whole. 

This playtest will let you access four new game modes:
[h3]Survival[/h3]
[i]everyone starts with a few lives; you win if you are still alive when eveyrone else runs out of lives![/i]
[h3]Team Deathmatch[/h3]
[i]like the deathmatch mode you played in the previous version, except points from kills is shared among your whole team![/i]
[h3]Team Survival[/h3]
[i]like survival, except everyone on the same team draws from a shared "bank" of lives[/i]
[h3]Capture The Flag[/h3]
[i]capture the enemy's flag and bring it back to your base, and stop the enemy from doing the same![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45219892/3a6089140b6285913cf36c6a0c2f2d01b6417c6a.png[/img]

The lobby experience has also been upgraded, with improved color contrast, and some lag prediction metrics.
The lobby list now shows each host's region and estimated latency (ping) before you join, so you can decide better which one to join for the best (lowest lag) experience.
While you're in a lobby, you'll also be able to see the ping between each individual player in the lobby and the host.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45219892/36949bfcea2f031a2db434feebe0fc366c4d8080.png[/img]

As always, you are welcome to join our [url=https://discord.gg/P8J8NhZ8nx]Discord[/url] for early updates, previews, events and more.
We definitely recommend hopping inside so you can find people to play with!

notes.title: Harry's Adventure - Playtest #1 is now open!
notes.content:
Sharpen your carrots, peel off your mittens, and prepare to stomp on some heads...
The first harry's adventure playtest cycle is now OPEN!

In this playtest cycle, we'll be testing the online versus mode. 
The single-player story mode is disabled, and will instead be playable in a future testing cycle when the world is more complete.

This version gives you access to two multiplayer stages and one game mode: 
* One small, one-screen stage, appropriate for around 8 players
* One larger stage in which the camera moves around with the player, and can fit a lot more rabbits!

Both stages are currently for the Deathmatch mode only -- so this test cycle will be all about hopping on the heads of other rabbits and getting the most kills. 
Future updates will include more stages, and more game modes.

The larger stage also has several food items spread around the stage, so you can dig them up for nice power-ups!


Online multi-player is no fun alone, so if you want to find other players to play against: 
Hop on in to the Cyber Nilssen discord:  https://discord.gg/P8J8NhZ8nx 

We have a channel specifically for organizing play sessions, and we'll also post future announcements there. Plus, there's a bunch of cool people inside in case you want to socialize 😎


Thank you for participating in the playtest!

Happy hopping,
Cyber Nilssen.
